about: The last re-score of this suite: FFM flown against the stored references, which are not rerun. consolidate.mjs carries the date and the evidence it did not re-score into consolidated.json and CONSOLIDATED.md; check-all.mjs prints the list.

notRescored.reason: Its reference, the Orekit run with -Dorekit.simpleEOP=true (full-simple-eop.json), is not stored in the suite; regenerating it runs Orekit.
